name: Nitrogen Fixation Network
notes: Two major nitrogen fixation systems: Mo-dependent (classical nifHDK) and V-dependent (alternative vnfHDGK). Both reduce atmospheric N2 to NH3. Mo-nif is most common; V-nif used when molybdenum is scarce. Fe-only system (anfHDGK) exists but not included here.

genes.name: nitrogenase iron protein
genes.notes: Fe protein component (dinitrogenase reductase). Delivers electrons to nifDK. Highly conserved marker gene for Mo-nif system.

genes.name: nitrogenase molybdenum-iron protein alpha chain
genes.notes: MoFe protein alpha subunit. Forms complex with nifK.

genes.name: nitrogenase molybdenum-iron protein beta chain
genes.notes: MoFe protein beta subunit. Forms complex with nifD.

genes.name: molybdenum nitrogenase complex
genes.notes: Complete Mo-dependent nitrogenase complex. nifH (Fe protein) delivers electrons to nifDK (MoFe protein). All three components required for N2 fixation.

genes.name: vanadium nitrogenase iron protein
genes.notes: Fe protein for V-nitrogenase. Analogous to nifH but works with VFe protein.

genes.name: vanadium-dependent nitrogenase alpha chain
genes.notes: VFe protein alpha subunit. Uses vanadium instead of molybdenum.

genes.name: vanadium nitrogenase complex
genes.notes: Complete V-dependent nitrogenase complex. vnfH (Fe protein) delivers electrons to vnfDKG (VFe protein). All four components required for N2 fixation. Alternative to Mo-nitrogenase when molybdenum is scarce.

genes.name: flavodoxin
genes.notes: Electron carrier protein that transfers electrons to nifH. Part of electron transfer chain but not core nitrogenase complex. Optional/accessory gene.

nitrogen_fixation.name: Nitrogen Fixation (Mo or V dependent)
nitrogen_fixation.notes: Biological nitrogen fixation via two alternative nitrogenase systems: Mo-dependent (classical, most common) or V-dependent (used when Mo is scarce). Both reduce N2 to NH3. Either complete system indicates N2 fixation capability. Diagnostic markers: nifH (Mo-nif specific) and vnfH (V-nif specific).

scoring.notes: Gap-based scoring finds complete route from N2 to NH3. Either Mo-nif (nifH + nifDK) OR V-nif (vnfH + vnfDKG) constitutes complete pathway. No partial functionality.
